prompt: A surreal cinematic scene: a man seen from behind, walking slowly toward an enormous sand hourglass standing on cracked, scorched earth under a merciless sun. Fine sand pours out faster through the growing fractures, pieces of stone flaking off in slow motion. The atmosphere is heavy, silent, except for the faint sound of crumbling stone. Heatwaves ripple across the golden, dusty landscape.
